root.label: Immich
root.shortDescription: Self-hosted photo and video management with server, web app, CLI, SDKs and plugins.
root.longDescription: Monorepo for a self-hosted photo and video library. A NestJS server exposes the REST API, runs background jobs and provides an admin CLI; a SvelteKit web app handles browsing and administration. A typed TypeScript SDK wraps the API for the web app and the upload CLI. Workflow plugins are written with a plugin SDK and compiled to WebAssembly, with core filters and actions shipped as a built-in plugin.

children.label: Immich Server
children.shortDescription: NestJS backend serving the Immich photo/video API, background jobs, and admin CLI.
children.longDescription: TypeScript NestJS server that exposes the REST and websocket API, runs microservice workers for media processing, ML, and sync jobs, and provides an admin CLI. A controller → service → repository stack is built on Kysely over PostgreSQL with vector extensions. It also includes a separate maintenance-mode worker, email templates, and generated SQL query snapshots.

children.label: App Bootstrap
children.shortDescription: Process entrypoints, Nest module wiring, CLI commands, maintenance worker, and build scripts.
children.longDescription: main.ts forks the api, microservices, and maintenance workers. app.module.ts assembles the controllers, services, and repositories into Nest modules for each worker type. nest-commander commands handle admin tasks such as password resets and toggling login methods. The maintenance folder holds a standalone guarded controller, service, and websocket for maintenance mode. The bin scripts regenerate the OpenAPI spec and SQL snapshots.

children.label: app.module
children.shortDescription: Defines Nest root modules for each process type: API, microservices, maintenance, admin CLI.
children.longDescription: BaseModule shares config, Kysely database, CLS, OpenTelemetry and repository/service providers. ApiModule adds controllers, global guards, pipes, interceptors, exception filter and scheduling. MicroservicesModule wires BullMQ job workers, MaintenanceModule hosts the standalone maintenance worker, and ImmichAdminModule registers nest-commander commands. Lifecycle hooks emit app bootstrap and shutdown events.

children.label: MaintenanceWorkerService
children.shortDescription: Runs maintenance-mode logic: auth, status, restore actions, and exiting back to normal.
children.longDescription: Verifies maintenance JWTs from cookies or headers and serves server config, version and ping replies while the API is down. Runs maintenance actions such as database restore under a database lock and broadcasts status over MaintenanceWebsocketRepository. Health-checks the API through MaintenanceHealthRepository before clearing maintenance mode in system metadata and restarting the app. Also handles SSR for the web UI.

children.label: sync-sql
children.shortDescription: Script that generates SQL query snapshots from repository methods marked with @GenerateSql.
children.longDescription: Boots a Nest testing module with real Kysely, config and repositories. Reflects over repository methods tagged with GENERATE_SQL_KEY and calls them with DummyValue parameters. SqlLogger captures the emitted SQL, formats it with sql-formatter, and writes one .sql file per repository so query changes appear in diffs.

children.label: main
children.shortDescription: Process entrypoint that forks API and microservices workers or runs admin CLI commands.
children.longDescription: The Workers class reads maintenance mode from system metadata through a short-lived Kysely connection. In maintenance mode it starts only the maintenance worker. Otherwise it waits for a free database lock and starts the enabled workers as child processes or worker threads. It handles restart and shutdown signals with a restart fail-safe, and hands off to CommandFactory for the immich-admin CLI.

children.label: MaintenanceWorkerController
children.shortDescription: HTTP endpoints exposed while the server runs in maintenance mode.
children.longDescription: Copies a subset of ServerController routes (ping, version, config) so clients keep working during maintenance. Adds maintenance login, status, detect-install and set-mode endpoints. Exposes database backup list, upload, download and delete through DatabaseBackupService. Routes carry MaintenanceRoute guards and delegate to MaintenanceWorkerService, setting cookies with respondWithCookie.

children.label: media-location command
children.shortDescription: CLI command that rewrites stored file paths for a new media location.
children.longDescription: Shows sample paths from the database, then prompts for the old and new media location values. Asks for confirmation before calling CliService.migrateFilePaths. On success it reminds the user to update IMMICH_MEDIA_LOCATION and the docker volume mounts. Prompts are defined as nest-commander QuestionSets.

children.label: eslint config
children.shortDescription: ESLint flat config for the server TypeScript code.
children.longDescription: Combines the recommended rule sets from unicorn, typescript-eslint and import-x, plus prettier compatibility, using type-aware parsing against tsconfig.json. Turns off many stylistic unicorn rules, enforces no-floating-promises, and applies project-specific import and naming rules.

children.label: app.common
children.shortDescription: Shared Express and telemetry setup used by API and maintenance workers.
children.longDescription: configureExpress sets the logger, trust proxy, CORS, helmet, cookie parsing, body limits and compression on the Nest Express app. It also installs the websocket adapter, Swagger docs, static web assets via sirv, and SSR middleware from either ApiService or MaintenanceWorkerService. configureTelemetry starts the metrics exporter when metrics are enabled.

children.label: MaintenanceWebsocketRepository
children.shortDescription: Socket.io gateway that pushes maintenance status and restart events to clients.
children.longDescription: Runs on /api/socket.io, the same path as the main API socket. It checks connecting clients with a pluggable auth function. Server-side MaintenanceStatus and AppRestart messages are forwarded to EventRepository, and versioned client events (MaintenanceStatusV1, AppRestartV1) are emitted to connected sockets.

children.label: grant-admin
children.shortDescription: CLI commands to grant or revoke admin rights by user email.
children.longDescription: GrantAdminCommand and RevokeAdminCommand ask for an email through a shared nest-commander question and call CliService.grantAdminAccess or revokeAdminAccess. Errors are logged to the console instead of thrown.

children.label: reset-admin-password
children.shortDescription: CLI command that resets the admin password, optionally invalidating sessions.
children.longDescription: Prints the details of the found admin, then prompts for an optional new password and whether to invalidate sessions. Calls CliService.resetAdminPassword and prints the generated password when none was provided.

children.label: MaintenanceHealthRepository
children.shortDescription: Verifies the API can start by forking a temporary API worker and pinging it.
children.longDescription: Forks workers/api.js on 127.0.0.1:33001 with inspector flags removed and output silenced. Polls /api/server/ping every second until a response or a 180s deadline. Rejects if the child exits early, and always kills the child once the check settles. Used before leaving maintenance mode.

children.label: Database Schema
children.shortDescription: Declarative PostgreSQL schema: tables, enums, SQL functions, and shared row types.
children.longDescription: Decorated table classes declare every table, including asset, album, person, the audit tables, the vector search tables, and the workflow tables. Columns are defined with custom decorators such as UUIDv7 primary keys and updated-at triggers. ImmichDatabase aggregates the tables, enums, and PL/pgSQL functions so migrations can be generated from them. database.ts defines the shared selected-row types and the transaction handle used by the repositories.

children.label: database
children.shortDescription: Shared row types for domain entities and a Kysely transaction handle wrapper.
children.longDescription: Defines plain TypeScript row shapes (User, Asset, Album users, Library, ApiKey, Memory, Tag, etc.) consumed by repositories and DTO mappers. TransactionHandle wraps a Kysely ControlledTransaction with commit, rollback, unwrap, and async-dispose that auto-rolls back uncommitted work. Types reference schema tables and enums from src/enum.js to keep query results typed.

children.label: SQL functions
children.shortDescription: Registers PostgreSQL functions and trigger bodies used by the declarative schema.
children.longDescription: Uses registerFunction from @immich/sql-tools to declare SQL and PL/pgSQL functions: a timestamp-ordered UUIDv7 generator, updated_at trigger setting updatedAt/updateId, immutable helpers for indexing (f_unaccent, f_concat_ws, ll_to_earth_public), and many *_delete_audit triggers that write deletions into audit tables for client sync. Referenced by table decorators and schema index.

children.label: decorators
children.shortDescription: Shared column, trigger, chunking, SQL-generation, telemetry, and event decorators.
children.longDescription: Provides schema helpers like UpdateIdColumn and UpdatedAtTrigger built on immich_uuid_v7 and updated_at. Chunked decorators split large parameter lists under PostgreSQL's 65535 bind limit. Also hosts NestJS-level decorators for SQL query generation metadata, telemetry, event handler registration, and OpenAPI annotations, making it a cross-cutting utility file.

children.label: schema index
children.shortDescription: Assembles all tables, enums, functions, and extensions into the ImmichDatabase definition.
children.longDescription: ImmichDatabase is the @Database-decorated root listing every table class, registered enum, SQL function, and required extension, which sql-tools diffs to produce migrations. The exported DB interface maps table names to row types for Kysely, giving repositories typed query builders. Migrations describes the migration bookkeeping table.

children.label: asset table
children.shortDescription: Declares the central asset table with indexes, triggers, and foreign keys.
children.longDescription: Defines AssetTable columns for owner, library, stack, checksum, visibility, status, and timestamps. Partial unique indexes enforce checksum uniqueness per user or per library; expression indexes on localDateTime support timeline day and month bucketing. Triggers maintain updatedAt, write delete audits, and propagate owner/visibility/deletion changes to asset_face rows.

children.label: asset face table
children.shortDescription: Declares detected face rows linking assets to person groups.
children.longDescription: AssetFaceTable stores bounding boxes, source type, and person group per asset, plus denormalized ownerId, assetVisibility, and assetDeletedAt copied from the asset by an insert trigger. The updatedAt trigger skips changes to those denormalized fields so they don't sync to clients. Partial composite indexes serve people timelines and visible-face queries; deletes are audited.

children.label: asset AV tables
children.shortDescription: Declares per-asset audio, video stream, and keyframe metadata tables.
children.longDescription: Three one-to-one tables keyed by assetId with cascade delete on AssetTable. AssetVideoTable records codec, bitrate, frame count, color metadata, Dolby Vision fields, and fragmentation; AssetAudioTable records codec and bitrate; AssetKeyframeTable stores keyframe data. Used by video transcoding and playback logic.

children.label: asset exif table
children.shortDescription: Declares EXIF metadata storage per asset, including geolocation and camera details.
children.longDescription: AssetExifTable is keyed by assetId and holds camera make/model, dimensions, file size, capture dates, lens and exposure data, and latitude/longitude. A GiST index on ll_to_earth_public enables radius geo searches. Imports LockableProperty from database.ts for user-locked fields and uses UpdatedAtTrigger for sync tracking.

children.label: enums
children.shortDescription: Registers PostgreSQL enum types mirrored from application enums.
children.longDescription: Calls registerEnum to create database enums for album roles, asset status, face source type, visibility, checksum algorithm, video codec variants, and person user roles. Values derive from TypeScript enums in src/enum.js and person DTOs so database and application stay aligned. Consumed by table column definitions and the schema index.

children.label: person table
children.shortDescription: Declares per-user person records referencing shared person groups.
children.longDescription: PersonTable uses a composite primary key of ownerId and personGroupId, storing name, thumbnail, hidden flag, and birth date with a check constraint against future dates. A trigram GIN index on f_unaccent(name) supports accent-insensitive search. Delete triggers write audit rows and clean up associated shares.

children.label: user table
children.shortDescription: Declares user accounts with credentials, quotas, profile, and soft deletion.
children.longDescription: UserTable holds email, password and PIN hashes, admin flag, OAuth id, storage label, avatar color, quota fields, and status. Soft deletion uses deletedAt; an index on (updatedAt, id) supports sync paging. Triggers maintain updatedAt/updateId and record deletions in the user audit table.

children.label: album user table
children.shortDescription: Declares album membership with roles, enforcing a single owner per album.
children.longDescription: AlbumUserTable joins albums and users with a composite primary key and role enum defaulting to editor. A partial unique index guarantees one owner per album. Statement triggers bump the parent album's updatedAt on non-owner inserts, audit deletions, and run album_user_delete row cleanup; createId/updateId columns support client sync.

Route-local components implement memories, duplicate comparison, person merging, workflow editing and user settings panels.

children.label: MemoryViewer
children.shortDescription: Full-screen memory slideshow with playback, navigation, and asset selection actions.
children.longDescription: Plays a memory's assets in a timed slideshow and lets the user move to the previous or next memory. The memoryManager supplies the data. A GalleryViewer grid lets users select assets and run timeline actions on them, such as favorite, delete, download, and change date or location. BirthdayConfetti, assetMultiSelectManager and onResourceDelete hooks keep the view in sync.

children.label: Album Page
children.shortDescription: Album detail page with timeline, sharing, activity, map and asset actions.
children.longDescription: Renders one album as a Timeline, with a ControlAppBar header showing the album summary, owner and shared user avatars, and an AlbumMap. Integrates ActivityViewer and ActivityStatus for comments and likes. Multi-select actions come from timeline action components such as delete, download, favorite, visibility and change metadata. Album-level operations appear in a ButtonContextMenu.

children.label: Person Page
children.shortDescription: Person detail page showing their timeline with rename, merge and hide controls.
children.longDescription: Displays all assets for a single recognized person in a Timeline. Supports view modes from PersonPageViewMode for naming, merging and selecting a featured photo, with suggestions navigable via listNavigation and clickOutside. Session storage keys preserve state. Multi-select actions reuse the shared timeline action components.

children.label: SharingSettings
children.shortDescription: Settings panel managing partner sharing and cluster group membership and requests.
children.longDescription: Lists partners and lets the user add, remove or toggle timeline inclusion through partner mutations. Manages cluster groups for shared face recognition: send, accept and delete join requests, leave groups and regenerate people. Uses TanStack queries via executeMutation and queryClient. Modals cover partner and cluster-group user selection.

children.label: Workflow Editor
children.shortDescription: Editor page for a workflow's trigger, metadata and ordered steps.
children.longDescription: Loads a workflow with createPreloadedQuery and keeps a cloned draft, so unsaved changes are detected with isEqual and guarded by beforeNavigate. Saves through updateWorkflowMutation.

children.label: WorkflowStepCard
children.shortDescription: Draggable card displaying one workflow step's method and configuration.
children.longDescription: Resolves the step's plugin method through pluginManager to get its schema and whether it is a filter. Renders config entries in readable form, resolving album and tag IDs to names via queryClient. Offers edit, delete and insert-before buttons, and drag handlers that mount a custom WorkflowStepDragImage.

children.label: Search Page
children.shortDescription: Search results page showing matched assets in a gallery with bulk actions.
children.longDescription: Builds a search from URL query parameters through searchManager and shows results in a paginated GalleryViewer, with a SearchBar in the ControlAppBar. children.label: Duplicates Page

Keyboard shortcuts drive navigation, and a ShortcutsModal documents them. Resolved groups are removed from the cache.

children.label: AlbumsControls

children.longDescription: Binds a search query and updates the persisted albumViewSettings store to change filter (all, owned, shared), group-by, sort order, and list or grid view. children.label: FaceThumbnail

children.label: DuplicatesCompareControl

children.label: SettingSelect

children.label: FFmpegSettings

children.label: AuthSettings

children.longDescription: Edits a cloned admin config for OAuth (issuer, client credentials, token endpoint auth method, mobile redirect override, scopes) and password login. children.label: MachineLearningSettings

children.label: ImageSettings

Fields are disabled when the config comes from a file, and changes are saved through SystemConfigButtonRow.

children.label: ServerStatisticsPanel

children.label: QueueCard

children.label: IntegrityChecksSettings

children.label: System Settings Page

children.label: Timeline

children.longDescription: Renders the month/day-grouped asset grid that TimelineManager drives. Only months intersecting the viewport render; the rest show as skeletons. children.label: Scrubber

children.label: Modals
children.shortDescription: Modal dialogs for confirmations, pickers, and create or edit forms.
children.longDescription: Flat folder of modal components opened through the UI library's modal manager. Includes album, people, tag and partner pickers, asset date, location and description editors, and API key, shared link and library forms. Also covers workflow step editors and logs, server about and shortcut help. timezone-utils supports the date-change modals with zone listing and offset calculation.

children.label: timezone-utils
children.shortDescription: Luxon helpers for listing time zones and computing offsets for date edits.
children.longDescription: Builds the sorted list of valid ZoneOption entries for a selected date using Intl.supportedValuesOf, filtering out zones where the local time is invalid due to DST gaps. Computes modern offsets by projecting dates into the current year, picks a preferred zone from user/initial values, and converts between ISO strings and Luxon DateTimes for the date-change modals.

children.label: AlbumPickerModal
children.shortDescription: Searchable album picker with recent albums, multi-select, and inline album creation.
children.longDescription: Loads all and recent albums via TanStack Svelte Query and converts them into rows with AlbumModalRowConverter using the user's album sort preferences. Supports keyboard row navigation, filtering by search text, multi-selecting albums, and creating a new album through createAlbumMutation. Returns chosen albums to the caller via onClose.

children.label: PersonBulkShareModal
children.shortDescription: Form modal for sharing people with users and setting per-user roles.
children.longDescription: Lets the owner pick a target user, toggle sharing everyone, and add or remove individual people, tracking pending changes in SvelteMap/SvelteSet. Opens PeopleSelectionModal through modalManager to choose people, then persists diffs with upsertPeopleUsersMutation and removeUsersFromPeopleMutation. Reports errors via handleError and toastManager.

children.label: GeolocationPointPickerModal
children.shortDescription: Map-based picker for choosing an asset's latitude/longitude via search or click.
children.longDescription: Combines an interactive Map, CoordinatesInput, and a debounced place search (searchPlacesQuery) with keyboard-navigable suggestions. Initializes the point from the asset's EXIF coordinates or a provided LatLng and coordinates with geolocationManager. Wrapped in a ConfirmModal that returns the selected point through onClose.

children.label: PersonMergeSuggestionModal
children.shortDescription: Confirms merging two people, with option to swap the merge target.
children.longDescription: Shows thumbnails of the person to merge and the target, letting the user swap direction or pick another candidate from potentialMergePeople via bindable props. On submit it runs mergePeopleMutation through executeMutation with success and error toasts, then returns the merged pair to the caller.

children.label: WorkflowLogsModal
children.shortDescription: Shows paginated execution logs for a workflow with result filtering.
children.longDescription: Uses createInfiniteQuery with getWorkflowLogsQuery to load log pages, fetching more when an IntersectionObserver sentinel scrolls into view. Lets users filter by WorkflowResult, toggle logging via updateWorkflowMutation, and open related routes. Renders entries in an @immich/ui Table with Luxon-formatted timestamps.

children.label: PeopleFilterModal
children.shortDescription: Form modal for filtering people by sharer, recipient, favorite, and hidden state.
children.longDescription: Initializes local state from a PeopleFilter and loads cluster-group users via getClusterGroupUsersQuery. Tri-state checkboxes cycle through true, false, and undefined; user filters open PeopleFilterUserPicker through modalManager. Returns the updated filter via onClose on submit.

children.label: AlbumOptionsModal
children.shortDescription: Album settings modal for sharing users, roles, links, and display options.
children.longDescription: Keeps the album fresh with getAlbumQuery and lists shared links via getAllSharedLinksQuery. Lets owners change user roles or remove users through album.service helpers, toggle activity and asset order with updateAlbumInfoMutation, and trigger AddUsers/CreateSharedLink actions from getAlbumActions. Supports a readOnly mode.

children.label: MapSettingsModal
children.shortDescription: Form modal for editing map display options and date-range filters.
children.longDescription: Copies the mapSettings preference store into local state and exposes switches for dark mode, favorites, archived, partner, and shared-album assets, plus asset panel visibility. Offers either a relative date range or custom DatePicker bounds using Luxon. Returns the edited settings via onClose for the caller to persist.

children.label: AssetSelectionChangeDateModal
children.shortDescription: Changes date and time zone, absolute or relative, for selected assets.
children.longDescription: Offers an absolute date with a time-zone Combobox or a relative DurationInput offset. Recomputes valid zones on date change using getTimezones and getPreferredTimeZone from timezone-utils. On submit filters to owned assets with getOwnedAssetsWithWarning and calls updateAssets from @immich/sdk, reporting failures via handleError.

children.label: PeopleSelectionModal
children.shortDescription: Searchable multi-select list of people split into named and unnamed groups.
children.longDescription: Filters people by normalized name search and separates named from unnamed entries, rendering thumbnails via getPeopleThumbnailUrl. Toggles selection in a bindable selectedPeople array and offers select-all/unselect-all ActionItems. Returns the selection through onClose; used by PersonBulkShareModal.

children.label: ShortcutsModal
children.shortDescription: Displays keyboard shortcuts for navigation and asset actions.
children.longDescription: Renders general and action shortcut lists, each entry pairing key combinations with a translated description and optional info tooltip. Default shortcuts are defined inline via svelte-i18n but can be overridden through the shortcuts prop. Uses authManager to tailor entries to the current user.

children.label: State Managers
children.shortDescription: Rune-based singleton managers and stores holding client state, events and websocket updates.
children.longDescription: Svelte 5 class-based singletons handle auth, the asset viewer, multi-select, editing and transforms, memories, search, casting, uploads, and typed app events. TimelineManager loads time buckets into months and days, computes justified layouts, tracks viewport proximity, and applies websocket asset updates. Legacy writable stores cover preferences, slideshow, upload queue and the socket.io websocket connection.

children.label: timeline types
children.shortDescription: Shared type definitions for timeline assets, options, viewport and pending changes.
children.longDescription: Declares the TimelineAsset shape used across the timeline, plus TimelineManagerOptions derived from the SDK getTimeBuckets request. Defines PendingChange as a discriminated union of add, update, delete and trash operations consumed by websocket handling, along with Viewport, Direction, ScrubberMonth and geometry option types.

children.label: TimelineManager
children.shortDescription: Rune-based controller for the virtualized photo timeline, its months, loading and updates.
children.longDescription: Extends VirtualScrollManager to hold TimelineMonth buckets fetched via getTimeBuckets, tracking viewport proximity, geometry and scroll position. Delegates layout, loading, search and intersection logic to internal support modules and applies websocket changes through WebsocketSupport. Reacts to authManager, eventManager and userPreferencesManager, and uses CancellableTask for initialization and month loads.

children.label: TimelineMonth
children.shortDescription: Reactive month bucket holding day groups, assets, layout and load state.
children.longDescription: Represents one year-month in the timeline, grouping assets into TimelineDay instances and tracking height, top offset and viewport proximity. Ingests TimeBucketAssetResponseDto columnar data, honors sort order and orderBy, and supports finding, moving and removing assets. Loads lazily through a CancellableTask and formats localized titles via svelte-i18n.

children.label: transformManager
children.shortDescription: Singleton state for crop, rotate and mirror editing in the asset editor.
children.longDescription: Implements EditToolManager for the transform tool, tracking crop region, aspect ratio, image scale, drag and resize interactions as runes. Converts regions between displayed and original image dimensions and normalizes edits into CropParameters and mirror/rotate actions. Loads asset previews via getAssetMediaUrl and is registered as a tool by EditManager.

children.label: TimelineDay
children.shortDescription: Day group within a month that lays out and windows its viewer assets.
children.longDescription: Holds the ViewerAssets for a single day, computes justified layout via getJustifiedLayoutFromAssets, and tracks its position, size and row/column within the month. Determines activeViewerAssets near the viewport using binary search over positions with TUNABLES expansion margins, so only visible thumbnails are rendered. Supports deferred layout and sorted insertion of assets.

children.label: preferences store
children.shortDescription: Persisted Svelte stores for locale, language, map, album and places view settings.
children.longDescription: Uses svelte-persisted-store to keep user UI preferences in localStorage, with custom serializers normalizing BCP47 locales and merging defaults into stored objects. Derives the effective formatting locale from the browser when set to default. Exposes enums and setting interfaces for album sort, grouping, filter and view modes plus places grouping.

children.label: assetViewerManager
children.shortDescription: Singleton holding asset viewer state: zoom, image loading, faces and panels.
children.longDescription: Extends BaseEventManager to emit Zoom, ZoomChange, Copy and FaceEditModeChange events to viewer components. Tracks zoom state for @zoom-image/core, the image element, loader quality status and a derived loading flag. Coordinates with authManager and userPreferencesManager, fetches asset info via the SDK, and checks clipboard copy capability.

children.label: search support
children.shortDescription: Lookup helpers for locating months and assets and navigating by offset.
children.longDescription: Provides functions TimelineManager uses to find the month containing an asset or date, retrieve asset ranges, and get neighboring assets by asset, day, month or year intervals. Compares ordering dates with luxon and plainDateTimeCompare and respects asset order direction. Kept separate from the manager to isolate traversal logic.

children.label: memoryManager
children.shortDescription: Singleton resolving memory viewer state and memory mutations from the current URL.
children.longDescription: Derives the active memory and asset from page params and query string, producing MemoryState with adjacent memories and navigation hrefs. Fetches memories through TanStack-style queries on queryClient and runs delete, update and asset-removal mutations, updating cached results. Converts assets with toTimelineAsset and navigates via goto.

children.label: websocket store
children.shortDescription: Socket.io connection and typed event emitter for server push updates.
children.longDescription: Opens an authenticated socket.io connection and re-emits server events such as uploads, asset trash/update, person thumbnails, notifications, releases and maintenance status. Handles app restarts and maintenance mode by invalidating queries and redirecting routes. Exposes a writable connection-state store and waitForWebsocketEvent for awaiting specific events, used by edit and timeline flows.

children.label: EditManager
children.shortDescription: Coordinates asset editing tools, unsaved changes and applying edits to the server.
children.longDescription: Registers edit tools (currently the transform tool with its component and transformManager) and tracks current asset, selected tool and apply state. Derives unsaved-change and reset availability from tool managers. Applies or removes edits via the SDK, waits for the websocket edit-confirmation event, and uses @immich/ui modals and toasts for confirmation and feedback.

children.label: slideshow store
children.shortDescription: Persisted and transient stores controlling slideshow playback and display options.
children.longDescription: Builds a store bundle with persisted settings for navigation order, look, delay, transitions, autoplay, repeat, progress bar and metadata overlay. Keeps transient writable state for play/pause/stop and restart or stop signals. Defines enums for slideshow state, navigation, look and metadata overlay mode.

children.label: Immich CLI
children.shortDescription: Command-line tool for uploading media and managing auth against an Immich server.
children.longDescription: Node CLI built on the generated Immich open-api client. Provides login/logout, server info, and bulk asset upload with watch mode, duplicate checking, sidecar detection, and album assignment. Uploads run through a concurrency-limited task queue, and credentials persist in a local auth file.

children.label: CLI Entry
children.shortDescription: Defines the command-line program and wires subcommands to handlers.
children.longDescription: Parses arguments and options for login, logout, server-info and upload, then dispatches to command handlers. Applies shared base options such as the config directory, server URL and API key, which are passed to the auth utilities.

children.label: CLI Entry
children.shortDescription: Defines the immich commander program and routes subcommands to their command handlers.
children.longDescription: Builds a commander Command with global options for config directory, server URL and API key, each overridable via IMMICH_* environment variables. Registers login, logout, server-info and upload subcommands, passing parsed arguments plus program.opts() to handlers in src/commands. Defaults concurrency to CPU count minus one and reads the version from package.json.

children.label: Commands
children.shortDescription: Implements upload, authentication and server-info subcommands.
children.longDescription: asset.ts crawls paths and checks hashes against the server to find duplicates. It uploads files with sidecars, optionally deletes originals, assigns albums from folder names, and supports a filesystem watch mode. auth.ts stores or removes credentials. server-info.ts reports server version and statistics. All commands use utils for connection and the queue for concurrency.

children.label: asset
children.shortDescription: Uploads local media files to an Immich server, with optional watch mode.
children.longDescription: Crawls directories for supported media types, hashes files with SHA-1, and calls checkBulkUpload to skip duplicates before uploading in concurrent batches through a Queue. Handles sidecar detection, album creation from folder names, deletion of uploaded or duplicate files, and cli-progress bars. Watch mode uses chokidar with a debounced Batcher to upload new files in groups of 100.

children.label: auth
children.shortDescription: Logs in with a server URL and API key, or logs out.
children.longDescription: login connects to the server, verifies the key has UserRead permission, fetches the current user via getMyUser, creates the config directory if needed, and writes the URL and key to the auth file. logout deletes the auth file from the configured directory if it exists. Exits the process on failure to load user info.

children.label: server-info
children.shortDescription: Prints server version, supported formats, and asset statistics for the user.
children.longDescription: Authenticates from stored credentials, checks ServerAbout, AssetStatistics and UserRead permissions, then fetches server version, supported media types, asset statistics and current user in parallel via the @immich/sdk. Writes a formatted summary to the console.

children.label: Core Utilities
children.shortDescription: Shared auth, server connection, error logging and task queue helpers.
children.longDescription: utils.ts handles login session files, authenticates with an API key, checks permissions, configures the open-api SDK connection, and formats errors. queue.ts provides a generic concurrency-limited Queue with retries that is used for batched hashing and uploads.

children.label: utils
children.shortDescription: Shared CLI helpers for authentication, server connection, auth files, file crawling and hashing.
children.longDescription: Resolves credentials from command options or a YAML auth file in the config directory, connects via @immich/sdk init and verifies the API key. Checks API key permissions with a cached getMyApiKey result, logs SDK HTTP and malformed-response errors, crawls paths with fast-glob, computes SHA-1 checksums from file streams, and provides a Batcher for grouping items.

children.label: queue
children.shortDescription: In-memory concurrent task queue with retries, built on fastq.
children.longDescription: Generic Queue<T, R> class that wraps a fastq promise queue and runs a worker function with configurable concurrency, retry count and verbosity. Each task is tracked in a Map with id, status, data, result, error and attempt count, so callers can inspect progress through tasks and getTask. Defaults are concurrency 1 with no retries.

children.label: Build Tooling
children.shortDescription: Build, test and lint configuration for the CLI package.
children.longDescription: vite.config.ts bundles the CLI into dist and configures vitest. eslint.config.mjs sets the TypeScript lint rules. Neither file ships as runtime code.

children.label: ESLint Config
children.shortDescription: Flat ESLint config combining TypeScript, Unicorn, and Prettier rules for the CLI.
children.longDescription: Builds the lint setup with typescriptEslint.config(), layering unicorn, prettier, core JS and typescript-eslint recommended presets. Enables type-aware linting via parserOptions.project pointing at tsconfig.json, with Node globals. Disables several opinionated unicorn rules, enforces no-floating-promises, curly braces, and the type-aware require-array-sort-compare instead of unicorn's version. Ignores dist and itself.

children.label: Vite Config
children.shortDescription: Vite build and Vitest config bundling the CLI into a single SSR Node output.
children.longDescription: Uses defineConfig() to build src/index.ts in SSR mode via rolldownOptions, writing to dist. ssr.noExternal bundles every dependency except node: built-ins, producing a self-contained CLI artifact. Resolves the src alias and tsconfig paths, and configures Vitest with the 'cli:unit' project name and global test APIs.

children.label: Immich Core Plugin
children.shortDescription: Built-in Immich plugin providing core workflow filters and actions, compiled for the plugin runtime.
children.longDescription: Bundles Immich's default plugin functionality as a single TypeScript entry point that the server's plugin host loads. Exposes core functions used by automation workflows, such as filtering and acting on assets. An esbuild script compiles the source into a self-contained bundle for the plugin runtime.

children.label: Plugin Functions
children.shortDescription: Core plugin entry point exporting workflow filter and action functions.
children.longDescription: Implements the plugin's exported functions in one file, which the Immich plugin host invokes during workflow execution. Reads input passed from the host, evaluates asset conditions or performs actions, and returns results to the host. Keeping all functions in a single entry file allows them to be bundled as one plugin artifact.

children.label: Core Plugin Entry
children.shortDescription: Defines built-in workflow filter and action functions for the Immich core plugin.
children.longDescription: Implements the core plugin's workflow steps using the wrapper from @immich/plugin-sdk, typed against the generated Manifest. Shared helpers listMatching() (all/any/none semantics) and matchValueResult() (contains, exact, startsWith, regex, present, missing, optional case sensitivity) return workflow continue decisions. Actions use @immich/sdk types such as AssetVisibility to modify assets.

children.label: Build Config
children.shortDescription: esbuild script bundling the plugin source into a deployable artifact.
children.longDescription: Small esbuild configuration that takes src/index.ts and emits a single bundled output for the plugin runtime. Inlines dependencies so the server can load the plugin without resolving node modules at runtime.

children.label: esbuild
children.shortDescription: Bundles the plugin's TypeScript source into a single CommonJS file in dist.
children.longDescription: Calls esbuild.build() with src/index.ts as the entry point and writes the bundled output to dist. The output is CommonJS and targets ES2020, because the QuickJS runtime that executes plugins supports neither ESM output nor newer syntax. Sourcemaps and minification are disabled, and a comment notes that minify could be turned on for production builds.

children.label: Immich Plugin SDK
children.shortDescription: TypeScript SDK and build tooling for writing Immich workflow plugins compiled to WebAssembly.
children.longDescription: Provides typed workflow event definitions, wrappers for plugin entry points, and bindings to host functions exposed by the Immich server. Includes a CLI and esbuild-based bundling so plugin authors can build manifests and packages. Plugins run in a sandboxed runtime and call back into the host through declared functions.

children.label: Workflow Types
children.shortDescription: Type definitions for workflow events, triggers, payloads, changes, and step configuration.
children.longDescription: Declares the event map linking triggers to their data payloads, plus response and change shapes that plugin steps return. Also defines step config and config value types. Shared by the SDK wrapper and host function bindings so plugin code and server agree on a typed contract.

children.label: types
children.shortDescription: Type definitions for workflow triggers, event payloads, step responses, and configuration values.
children.longDescription: Defines the contract between the Immich server and plugin workflow steps: the WorkflowTrigger enum, the payload a step receives (trigger, typed data, config, workflow id/auth token), and the WorkflowResponse a step returns (continue flag, changes, data, config). Maps WorkflowType from @immich/sdk to event data shapes such as AssetV1, and uses a recursive DeepPartial so changes can be partial asset updates.

children.label: Plugin Runtime
children.shortDescription: Wraps plugin step functions and exposes host function bindings to plugin code.
children.longDescription: The wrapper in sdk.ts adapts author-written handlers to the runtime calling convention, decoding input events and encoding workflow responses. host-functions.ts declares the functions the Immich host provides and lists them in availableFunctions. index.ts re-exports the public API for plugin authors.

children.label: index
children.shortDescription: Barrel entry point re-exporting the plugin SDK's host functions, wrapper, and types.
children.longDescription: Public entry for @immich/plugin-sdk. Re-exports everything from host-functions, sdk, and types so plugin authors import a single module. Contains no logic of its own.

children.label: host-functions
children.shortDescription: Typed bindings that let plugin code call Immich host functions via Extism.
children.longDescription: Declares the allowed host function names (album search/creation, adding assets to albums, bulk tagging, HTTP requests) and augments the extism:host module typing. hostFunctions() builds a client bound to an auth token that serializes {authToken, args} into Extism Memory, invokes the host, and parses a success/error result envelope, throwing on failure. Reuses DTO types from @immich/sdk.

children.label: sdk
children.shortDescription: Wraps plugin workflow step methods with typed config and host function access.
children.longDescription: Exports wrapper(), which takes a map of named step methods and adapts them into plugin exports that receive a WorkflowEventPayload plus bound host functions. Heavy type-level machinery (Property, GetConfigType, ConfigValue, RequiredProperties) derives each step's config type from its JSON-schema-like definition, enforcing required versus optional fields at compile time.

children.label: Build Tooling
children.shortDescription: CLI, manifest schema, and esbuild bundling used to package plugins.
children.longDescription: cli.ts defines the Manifest type and command-line entry for building plugins. plugin-sdk.mjs is the executable launcher for that CLI. esbuild.js bundles the SDK sources into distributable output. Together they turn plugin source into an artifact the Immich server can load.

children.label: cli
children.shortDescription: Commander CLI that generates Extism type declarations from a plugin manifest.
children.longDescription: Defines the plugin-sdk command with a prepareBuild subcommand that reads manifest.json, extracts method names, and writes a .d.ts file (default dist/index.d.ts). The output declares 'extism:host' user functions from availableFunctions in host-functions.js, 'main' module exports returning I32, and a Manifest type inlined from the raw manifest JSON.

children.label: esbuild config
children.shortDescription: Bundles the SDK library and CLI entry points into ESM output in dist.
children.longDescription: Invokes esbuild.build on src/index.ts and src/cli.ts, producing bundled, unminified ES2020 ESM modules targeting Node in the dist directory. Sourcemaps are disabled. Its dist/cli.js output is what the plugin-sdk.mjs bin shim loads.

children.label: bin shim
children.shortDescription: Node executable entry point that loads the bundled CLI.
children.longDescription: Two-line shebang script exposed as the package binary. It imports ./dist/cli.js, so the CLI runs from the esbuild output and not from TypeScript sources, which means a build must run before the command works.

children.label: Immich TypeScript SDK
children.shortDescription: Typed TypeScript client for calling the Immich server REST API.
children.longDescription: Wraps a generated fetch-based client covering every Immich API endpoint and DTO. A small hand-written entry point configures base URL, API key and headers globally and re-exports the generated functions. Error helpers classify HTTP and malformed responses. Consumed by the Immich CLI and web app.

children.label: Generated API Client
children.shortDescription: OpenAPI-generated endpoint functions and DTO types for the Immich API.
children.longDescription: Machine-generated from the server's OpenAPI spec with oazapfts, exposing one async function per endpoint plus request/response DTO types and enums. Holds shared mutable `defaults` (baseUrl, headers, fetch) and `servers` that the entry module mutates. Not edited by hand; regenerated when the server API changes.

children.label: fetch-client
children.shortDescription: Generated typed fetch client exposing every Immich API endpoint and DTO type.
children.longDescription: Generated by oazapfts from the Immich OpenAPI spec and marked do-not-modify. It declares TypeScript DTO types such as UserResponseDto, ActivityResponseDto and the AdminConfig* family. It also exports one async function per endpoint, built on the @oazapfts/runtime fetch wrapper and its query-string helpers. A shared mutable defaults object sets baseUrl ('/api') and headers, letting consumers configure auth and server location globally.

children.label: SDK Entry Point
children.shortDescription: Public entry that configures base URL, API key and headers for requests.
children.longDescription: Re-exports the generated client and error helpers, and provides `init`, `setBaseUrl`, `setApiKey`, `setHeader(s)` and `getBaseUrl` that mutate the generated client's `defaults`. Also exposes `jsonOnly` for unwrapping responses. Gives consumers a single import surface with simple global configuration.

children.label: SDK index
children.shortDescription: Configures base URL, API key and headers, and re-exports the generated fetch client.
children.longDescription: Public entry point that re-exports the generated fetch-client and fetch-errors modules and mutates their shared defaults for base URL and headers. setApiKey() is the only way to set x-api-key; setHeader()/setHeaders() reject it. jsonOnly() wraps fetch to throw MalformedResponseError when a JSON response is expected but not returned. Also provides path helpers for asset originals, thumbnails, playback and profile images.

children.label: Error Types
children.shortDescription: Typed API error shapes and guards for HTTP and malformed responses.
children.longDescription: Defines interfaces for validation and exception payloads returned by the server, an `ApiHttpError` shape, and a `MalformedResponseError` class. Type guards `isHttpError` and `isMalformedResponseError` let callers narrow caught errors from generated client calls without inspecting raw responses.

children.label: fetch-errors
children.shortDescription: Defines typed API error shapes and type guards for HTTP and malformed responses.
children.longDescription: Declares the server's exception payload (ApiExceptionResponse with optional ApiValidationError list) and ApiHttpError, which narrows oazapfts' HttpError to carry that payload. isHttpError() checks instanceof HttpError from @oazapfts/runtime. MalformedResponseError records url, status and content-type for responses that cannot be parsed, with a formatted message and its own isMalformedResponseError() guard.

children.shortDescription: Third-party services and backends Immich talks to.
children.longDescription: Detected from SDK imports, API hosts, *_URL settings and webhook routes: Redis, Email provider, Realtime server.
